title: Recover From An Ambiguous Selector With An Explicit ID
task: Using docxedit only, arrange or find two paragraphs with identical visible text in a run-directory copy of the input.
Attempt a replace-text edit through a text selector that matches both paragraphs and record the diagnostic code, match count, and candidate IDs.
Recover by retargeting exactly one paragraph with an explicit ID plus an expect-text guard. Do not use occurrence to select between selector targets.
Run docxedit check before each apply and validate the final output with docxedit read and docxedit validate.
successCriteria: Produces an output .docx where only the chosen paragraph changed.
Shows the ambiguous check failing with E1202 before the recovery.
Does not inspect raw OOXML package parts or quote private document text.
observerQuestions: Did the E1202 diagnostic name the candidate IDs and the explicit-ID recovery?
Did the agent avoid misapplying occurrence to selector ambiguity?
Could the agent verify the surgical result from docxedit output alone?
